answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by forcing each new identity to strike a unique bond-tool at a public forge, then berth that tool at one cargo wharf before it can earn. The agent locks 1.1 POA for five epochs and stamps a 900-second sequential nonce chain so extra machines cannot skip the heat-up. Auditors whisper-sample four earlier tools, recompute each chain, and match the wharf slate's Merkle leaf to the live tip. A failed sample costs 0.03 POA. If two tools share a nonce prefix or a lock lifts early, both bonds slash 70 percent and that slip stays sealed for three epochs.
